abstract: Nine phenotypic female patients with XY karyotype were evaluated through a clinical, cytogenetic, hormonal, endoscopic and histologic diagnostic protocol. Seven patients complained of primary amenorrhea and two patients of abnormal puberal development. The final diagnosis was XY gonadal dysgenesis (n = 5) and testicular feminization syndrome (n = 4). Two patients were less than 155 cm tall, and the remainder were over 155. Minor somatic anomalies were found in two patients with XY gonadal dysgenesis. Patient with testicular feminization syndrome had FSH and LH within the normal range, and patients with XY gonadal dysgenesis had elevated FSH and LH levels. Gonadoblastomas were found in two patients with XY gonadal dysgenesis (one patient with XO/XX/XY mosaicism). Laparoscopy and gonadal biopsy might be useful in some patients to avoid confusion between XY gonadal dysgenesis and testicular feminization syndrome. Early diagnosis of XY gonadal dysgenesis is always desirable, and bilateral gonadectomy is indicated as soon as the diagnosis is made in patients with a Y chromosome and elevated FSH levels. Surgical removal of the gonads from patients with testicular feminization should be delayed until the completion of puberty because of the low risk of malignancy.
abstract_ja: XY核型を有する表現型女性9例を、臨床、細胞遺伝学、ホルモン、内視鏡、組織学的な診断手順に基づいて評価した。7例は原発性無月経、2例は思春期発育異常を主訴とした。最終診断はXY性腺異形成5例と精巣性女性化症候群4例であった。XY性腺異形成の2例では性腺芽腫が認められた。XY性腺異形成の患者では低身長や軽微な身体的奇形を伴うものがあった。精巣性女性化症候群の患者のFSHおよびLHは正常範囲内であったが、XY性腺異形成の患者ではFSHおよびLHが上昇していた。腹腔鏡検査と性腺生検は、XY性腺異形成と精巣性女性化症候群の鑑別に有用な場合がある。Y染色体を有しFSHが上昇している患者では、診断確定後直ちに両側性腺摘除を行うことが望ましい。精巣性女性化症の患者では悪性化のリスクが低いため、性腺摘除は思春期終了まで延期すべきである。
